Name: Haley and Emily Portraits By dulyignored (CP)
Author: dulyignored
Description:
REQUIRES SMAPI & CONTENT PATCHER

Changes Haley + Emily's default and beach portraits/sprites to my redesigns, with a vanilla-compliant art style. Colour palettes lean closer to that of the beta designs, with Emily's shorter hair also conceptually pulled from one of her beta designs. Amends Haley's overly saturated palette and spaghetti hair, and Emily's ghoulish paleness and sprite-inconsistent hair. They now have some similar features, making them look more like siblings.
